mentions.name: Autocue
mentions.description: An auto-following autocue/teleprompter web app that runs entirely on local AI. A Python server handles the recording, transcribes speech with Vosk (or a choice of other models), and runs an algorithm to track the speaker's position in the script. It serves a single page connected via WebSocket to render the script and live position updates, aiming to be better for direct-to-camera YouTube recording than free teleprompter apps that scroll at a fixed speed.
mentions.problem: Existing free teleprompter apps just scroll the script at a fixed speed instead of following the speaker's actual position.
mentions.audience: People recording YouTube videos direct to camera.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A prototype of an auto-following autocue/teleprompter.

Uses local-AI-only. It’s a web app but not using in-browser transcribe. Ive found it to be way better for recording YouTube videos direct to-camera than the existing free apps which just scroll at a fixed speed.
